title: Average the endpoints
text: For a linear piece, the integral over that piece is its width times the average of its two endpoint values. Add the pieces.

title: Evaluate
text: The pieces give $$\frac{2\left(0+1\right)}{2}=1$$, $$\frac{2\left(1+3\right)}{2}=4$$, $$\frac{1\left(3+0\right)}{2}=1.5$$, $$\frac{1\left(0+0\right)}{2}=0$$, and $$\frac{2\left(0+3\right)}{2}=3$$. The total is $$9.5=\frac{19}{2}$$.
